name: Promotional text campaign plan
summary: Before a promotional text campaign goes out, the marketing lead gets one plan: draft messages built only from the approved offer, the eligible audience as your own consent records define it, how often each person would be texted, the opt-out path and every open question. A person approves and sends.

sources.title: Its own method for planning a promotional text campaign for approval: the fixed inputs, the sorting of each contact against the company's own messaging policy, the message rules, the schedule and frequency checks, the opt-out and help path, and the open questions for named people.
